skill.name: verify
skill.description: Validates React changes by running formatting, linting, type checks, and targeted test workflows before commit.
skill.summary: Run the required React contribution checks and receive a clear success or failure summary.
skill.author: react

security_audit.summary: All five static findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline-code formatting around fixed verification commands. No prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or other semantic security issue was found in SKILL.md.

static_findings.snippet: 1. Run `yarn prettier` - format code (stop if fails)
2. Run `yarn linc` - lint changed files (stop if fails)
1. Use `/flow` to type check (stop if fails)
2. Use `/test` to test changes in source (stop if fails)
3. Use `/test www` to test changes in www (stop if fails)

finding_verdicts.reason: The backticks on line 16 are Markdown inline-code delimiters, not Ruby or shell command substitution. The fixed yarn prettier command does not construct a command from user input.
The backticks on line 17 only format a fixed yarn linc command in Markdown. No executable Ruby code or user-controlled command construction is present.
The backticks on line 20 format the fixed /flow skill reference in Markdown. They do not perform shell execution or interpolate user-controlled data.
The backticks on line 21 format the fixed /test skill reference in Markdown. No Ruby execution syntax or dynamic shell command is present.
The backticks on line 22 format the fixed /test www skill reference in Markdown. The text does not execute through Ruby or build a command from untrusted input.

content.value_statement: React contributions require several checks that are easy to miss or run in the wrong order. This skill coordinates formatting, linting, typing, and tests.
actual_capabilities: Runs yarn prettier before other verification steps.
Runs yarn linc to lint changed files.
Invokes the Flow check through the /flow workflow.
Runs source tests through the /test workflow.
Runs www tests through the /test www workflow.
Stops on failure and reports suggested fixes.
limitations: Requires the React repository and its dependencies to be available.
Depends on yarn scripts and companion /flow and /test workflows.
Stops at the first formatting or linting failure.
Does not commit changes or repair failures automatically.

use_cases.title: Validate a first contribution
use_cases.description: Run the standard checks before opening a React pull request.

use_cases.title: Check an implementation change
use_cases.description: Verify formatting, types, and source tests after modifying React code.

use_cases.title: Confirm website changes
use_cases.description: Run both source and www test workflows before review.

prompt_templates.title: Run standard verification
prompt_templates.scenario: Use after a small local change.

prompt_templates.title: Verify before commit
prompt_templates.prompt: Run every required verification step and summarize any failure before I commit.

prompt_templates.title: Verify a focused change
prompt_templates.prompt: Verify my changes using the test pattern {test pattern}, then report failed checks and suggested fixes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a specific test area needs attention.

prompt_templates.title: Perform release-grade verification
prompt_templates.prompt: Run formatting and linting first, then coordinate type checks, source tests, and www tests. Stop on failure and provide a concise diagnosis.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for broad or high-impact React changes.

output_examples.output: Verification passed. Formatting, changed-file linting, Flow checks, source tests, and www tests completed successfully.
Verification stopped during changed-file linting. Review the reported lint issue, apply the suggested fix, and run verification again.
Formatting and linting passed. Type checking passed, but the targeted source test failed. The failure summary identifies the affected test.

best_practices: Run verification after dependencies are installed and repository setup is complete.
Provide a focused test pattern when validating a specific subsystem.
Resolve the first reported failure before rerunning the complete workflow.
anti_patterns: Do not treat verification as a replacement for human code review.
Do not ignore a stopped workflow or assume later checks passed.
Do not run the skill outside a compatible React repository.

faq.question: What checks does this skill run?
faq.answer: It runs formatting, changed-file linting, Flow type checks, source tests, and www tests.

faq.question: Does it modify files?
faq.answer: The yarn prettier step may update formatting. The skill does not commit changes.

faq.question: What happens when a check fails?
faq.answer: The workflow stops and reports the failure with suggested fixes.

faq.question: Can I provide a test pattern?
faq.answer: Yes. Supply a test pattern to focus the test step.

faq.question: Can checks run in parallel?
faq.answer: Flow, source tests, and www tests run with subagents after formatting and linting succeed.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Use a configured React repository with Yarn dependencies and the /flow and /test workflows available.
